welcome.title: 🧠 Cérebro detected a new signal…
welcome.body: {mention}, your power signature just showed up on our sensors. To join the Legion, register your hero: it takes less than a minute.
welcome.persistent_body: Just arrived? Click the button below to register your hero.
welcome.back: 🧠 Signal recognized. Welcome back, **{codename}**! Your roles were restored.

rules.title: 📜 Legion rules
rules.summary:
1. Respect everyone.
2. No spam, no self-promotion without permission.
3. Original characters only: no Marvel hero or villain names.
4. Follow staff guidance.

xmen.name: X-Men
xmen.description: They protect a world that fears them.

independent.name: Independent
independent.description: No flag: you walk your own path.

archetype.title: 🧬 Choose your archetype
archetype.body: Your archetype sets your base stats. Then you describe your power in your own words.
archetype.Telepata: Sharp mind: high focus, low defense.
archetype.Tanque: Takes every hit: lots of HP and defense.
archetype.Tecnopata: Talks to machines: focus and defense.

modal.title: Hero sheet
modal.power_placeholder: E.g. Creates sparks that blind enemies
modal.origin_placeholder: How did you get your powers?

errors.canon_name: 🚫 **{codename}** looks like a Marvel character name. The Legion only accepts **original** heroes: invent a codename of your own!
errors.codename_length: The codename must have between {min} and {max} characters.
errors.codename_chars: Use only letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes in the codename.
errors.codename_taken: The codename **{codename}** already belongs to another hero. Pick another one.
errors.power_length: Describe your power in up to 100 characters.
errors.origin_length: Tell your story in up to 300 characters.
errors.invalid_choice: That option is not available. Try again.
errors.continue: Let's continue where you left off:
errors.not_staff: Only staff (Professor X or the Council) can use this command.
errors.role_permission: I couldn't adjust your roles right now. Staff can see it in the logs, and I'll try again shortly.
errors.not_registered_self: You are not a registered hero yet. Start in {channel}.
errors.power_origin: That power is not available for your origin. Pick another one.

registered.title: ✅ Hero registered!
registered.body: Welcome to the Legion, **{codename}**. The server is now unlocked for you.
registered.public_body: A new hero joined the Legion: **{codename}**.

profile.title: {emoji} {codename}
profile.not_registered: That member is not a registered hero yet.

optins.title: 🔔 Preferences
optins.body: Turn the optional roles on or off. Click again to switch.

setup.dry_run: 🔎 **Dry run** (nothing changed). Run with `aplicar: true` to apply.
setup.hierarchy_warning: ⚠️ My role is below these roles, so I can't assign them: {roles}. Drag the bot role above them in Server Settings → Roles.

help.perfil: Shows your hero sheet (or another member's).
help.preferencias: Turns optional roles on and off, like Live alerts.
help.setup: Syncs roles and, if asked, channel visibility.
help.status: Shows how many members are at each registration step.
help.heroi_poderes: Picks catalog powers for an already registered hero (once)
help.heroi_origem: Picks your hero's origin (once, for heroes registered before origins)

cerebro.preferencias: Turn optional roles on and off

heroi.poderes: Picks your powers from the catalog (once)
heroi.origem: Picks your origin (once, heroes from before origins)

powers.main_body: Your main power type sets your archetype and base stats. Then you pick secondary powers and describe it all in your own words.
powers.archetype_kept: Your archetype stays **{archetype}** (staff has not allowed changing it).
powers.secondary_body: Pick up to {max} secondary powers in the menus below, or go on without them. They show on your sheet and do not change stats.
powers.no_secondary: This server does not use secondary powers.
powers.already_list: You already chose your powers: {powers}. Ask staff if you need to change them.
powers.disabled: The power catalog is off on this server.

origin_step.title: 🌟 Choose your origin
origin_step.body: Where do your powers come from? Your origin decides which powers you can pick. It does not change your stats: those come from archetype and level. Every hero starts Independent and can join a team through recruitment missions.

origin_change.title: 🌟 Choose your origin (once)
origin_change.body: Your hero was registered before origins existed and became a Mutant. You may pick another origin **only once**. Powers that fit the new origin stay; if any does not fit, you pick again.
origin_change.cancelled: Nothing changed. You can still use `/heroi origem` later.
origin_change.used: The origin change is only for heroes registered before origins, and only once. Ask the staff if you need help.
origin_change.pick_powers: Some powers do not fit **{origin}**. Pick your powers again (or cancel to keep everything).
origin_change.saved: ✅ Origin saved: **{origin}**. Your powers stay the same.
origin_change.hint: 💡 New: every hero now has an origin. You can pick yours once with `/heroi origem`.

mutante.name: Mutant
mutante.description: Born with the X-gene: the powers woke up on their own.

inumano.name: Inhuman
inumano.description: Inherited latent powers, woken by the Terrigen mist.

ciencia.name: Science
ciencia.description: An experiment, accident or serum changed your body.

tecnologia.name: Technology
tecnologia.description: Your powers come from armor, weapons and gadgets.

mistico.name: Mystic
mistico.description: Wields magic, artifacts or pacts with other dimensions.

cosmico.name: Cosmic
cosmico.description: Gained power from a source among the stars.

treinado.name: Trained
treinado.description: No superpowers: skill, discipline and courage.
